Chipped Vest.title: Chipped Vest
Chipped Vest.lore: It doesn't look like much, but it's oddly comfy.

Blink Dagger.title: Blink Dagger
Blink Dagger.lore: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.

Band of Elvenskin.title: Band of Elvenskin
Band of Elvenskin.image: Band of Elvenskin itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Band of Elvenskin.lore: A tensile fabric often used for its light weight and ease of movement.

Abyssal Blade.title: Abyssal Blade
Abyssal Blade.lore: The lost blade of the Commander of the Abyss, this edge cuts into an enemy's soul.

Chainmail.title: Chainmail
Chainmail.lore: A medium weave of metal chains.

Battle Fury.title: Battle Fury
Battle Fury.lore: The bearer of this mighty axe gains the ability to cut down swaths of enemies at once.

Cheese.title: Cheese
Cheese.lore: Made from the milk of a long lost Furbolg vendor, it restores the vitality of those who taste it.

Circlet.title: Circlet
Circlet.lore: An elegant circlet designed for human princesses.

Clarity.title: Clarity
Clarity.lore: Clear water that enhances the ability to meditate.

Aegis of the Immortal.title: Aegis of the Immortal
Aegis of the Immortal.image: Aegis of the Immortal itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Aegis of the Immortal.lore: The Immortal was said to own a shield that protected him from death itself.

Claymore.title: Claymore
Claymore.lore: A sword that can cut through armor, it's a commonly chosen first weapon for budding swordsmen.

Cloak.title: Cloak
Cloak.lore: A cloak made of a magical material that works to dispel any magic cast on it.

Cloak of Flames.title: Cloak of Flames
Cloak of Flames.lore: A very fine cloak that plays host to an overly-protective living flame.

Aeon Disk.title: Aeon Disk
Aeon Disk.lore: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the [[Ivory Incubarium]]. Or so many believe.

Belt of Strength.title: Belt of Strength
Belt of Strength.image: Belt of Strength itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Belt of Strength.lore: A valued accessory for improving vitality.

Crimson Guard.title: Crimson Guard
Crimson Guard.lore: A cuirass originally built to protect against the dreaded Year Beast.

Black King Bar.title: Black King Bar
Black King Bar.image: Black King Bar itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Black King Bar.lore: A powerful staff imbued with the strength of giants.

Aether Lens.title: Aether Lens
Aether Lens.lore: Polished with the incantation of his final breath, the gift of a dying mage to his sickly son.

Blade Mail.title: Blade Mail
Blade Mail.lore: A razor-sharp coat of mail, it is the choice of selfless martyrs in combat.

Aghanim's Blessing.title: Aghanim's Blessing
Aghanim's Blessing.lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

Aghanim's Scepter.title: Aghanim's Scepter
Aghanim's Scepter.lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

Blade of Alacrity.title: Blade of Alacrity
Blade of Alacrity.image: Blade of Alacrity itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Blade of Alacrity.lore: A long blade imbued with time magic.

Blades of Attack.title: Blades of Attack
Blades of Attack.image: Blades of Attack itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Blades of Attack.lore: The damage of these small, concealable blades should not be underestimated.

Blitz Knuckles.title: Blitz Knuckles
Blitz Knuckles.lore: An underground arcanist's update of a back-alley classic.

Block of Cheese.title: Block of Cheese
Block of Cheese.image: Block of Cheese itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Block of Cheese.lore: First there was the Belt of Strength. Then there were the Boots of Travel. Now, at long last, the Block of Cheese.

Blood Grenade.title: Blood Grenade
Blood Grenade.lore: Both the hunter and the hunted must pay the blood price.

Bloodstone.title: Bloodstone
Bloodstone.lore: The Bloodstone's bright ruby color is unmistakable on the battlefield, as the owner seems to have infinite vitality and spirit.

Aghanim's Shard.title: Aghanim's Shard
Aghanim's Shard.lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.

Bloodthorn.title: Bloodthorn
Bloodthorn.lore: A reviled blade that bites deeper with each wriggle of its victim's final throes.

Arcane Blink.title: Arcane Blink
Arcane Blink.lore: A revitalizing tool to help bear the weight of arcane expenditure.

Arcane Boots.title: Arcane Boots
Arcane Boots.lore: Magi equipped with these boots are valued in battle.

Book of the Dead.title: Book of the Dead
Book of the Dead.image: Book of the Dead itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Book of the Dead.lore: A record of the final reckoning. With one page torn out.

Boots of Bearing.title: Boots of Bearing
Boots of Bearing.image: Boots of Bearing itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Boots of Bearing.lore: Resplendent footwear fashioned for the ancient herald that first dared spread the glory of Stonehall beyond the original borders of its nascent claim.

Armlet of Mordiggian.title: Armlet of Mordiggian
Armlet of Mordiggian.image: Armlet of Mordiggian itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Armlet of Mordiggian.image1: Armlet of Mordiggian (Inactive) itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Armlet of Mordiggian.image2: Armlet of Mordiggian (Active) itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Armlet of Mordiggian.lore: Weapon of choice among brutes, the bearer sacrifices his life energy to gain immense strength and power.

Boots of Speed.title: Boots of Speed
Boots of Speed.image: Boots of Speed itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Bottle.title: Bottle
Bottle.lore: An old bottle that survived the ages, the contents placed inside become enchanted.

Assault Cuirass.title: Assault Cuirass
Assault Cuirass.lore: Forged in the depths of the nether reaches, this hellish mail provides an army with increased armor and attack speed.

Broadsword.title: Broadsword
Broadsword.lore: The classic weapon of choice for knights, this blade is sturdy and reliable for slaying enemies.

Buckler.title: Buckler
Buckler.lore: A powerful shield that imbues the bearer with the strength of heroes past, it is capable of protecting entire armies in battle.

Butterfly.title: Butterfly
Butterfly.lore: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.

Bracer.title: Bracer
Bracer.lore: The bracer is a common choice to toughen up defenses and increase longevity.

Bag of Gold.title: Bag of Gold
Bag of Gold.image: Bag of Gold itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Ash Legion Shield.title: Ash Legion Shield
Ash Legion Shield.image: Ash Legion Shield itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Fallen Sky.title: Fallen Sky
Fallen Sky.lore: One of the few surviving creations of the acolytes of the Wyrmforge.

Essence Ring.title: Essence Ring
Essence Ring.lore: An ancient bauble blessed by the breath of Verodicia.

Dagger of Ristul.title: Dagger of Ristul
Dagger of Ristul.lore: A sinister shiv that grants favor to those willing to stain its blade with a sacrifice of their own blood.

Daedalus.title: Daedalus
Daedalus.lore: A weapon of incredible power that is difficult for even the strongest of warriors to control.

Eaglesong.title: Eaglesong
Eaglesong.lore: Capturing the majestic call of an eagle, this mystical horn brings limitless dexterity to those who hear it.

Gauntlets of Strength.title: Gauntlets of Strength
Gauntlets of Strength.image: Gauntlets of Strength itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Gauntlets of Strength.lore: Studded leather gloves that add brute strength.

Faerie Fire.title: Faerie Fire
Faerie Fire.lore: The ethereal flames from the ever-burning ruins of Kindertree ignite across realities.

Echo Sabre.title: Echo Sabre
Echo Sabre.lore: A deceptively swift blade imbued with resonant magic.

Gem of True Sight.title: Gem of True Sight
Gem of True Sight.image: Gem of True Sight itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Gem of True Sight.lore:
Not one thrall creature of the depths,
Nor spirit bound in drowning's keep,
Nor [[Maelrawn the Tentacular]],
Shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.

Falcon Blade.title: Falcon Blade
Falcon Blade.lore: An enchanted blade that long ago raised a hopeless urchin from pauper to king.

Fluffy Hat.title: Fluffy Hat
Fluffy Hat.lore: Fine and functional foppery for the fashion-forward fighter.

Ghost Scepter.title: Ghost Scepter
Ghost Scepter.lore: Imbues the wielder with a ghostly presence, allowing them to evade physical damage.

Demon Edge.title: Demon Edge
Demon Edge.lore: One of the oldest weapons forged by the Demon-Smith Abzidian, it killed its maker when he tested its edge.

Force Staff.title: Force Staff
Force Staff.lore: Allows you to manipulate others, for good or evil.

Desolator.title: Desolator
Desolator.lore: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.

Gleipnir.title: Gleipnir
Gleipnir.lore: Bindings forged by impossible means to leash an [[Primal Beast|ancient evil]].

Enchanted Mango.title: Enchanted Mango
Enchanted Mango.lore: The bittersweet flavors of Jidi Isle are irresistible to amphibians.

Diadem.title: Diadem
Diadem.lore: A crown that can never be removed.

Diffusal Blade.title: Diffusal Blade
Diffusal Blade.lore: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.

Glimmer Cape.title: Glimmer Cape
Glimmer Cape.lore: The stolen cape of a master illusionist.

Energy Booster.title: Energy Booster
Energy Booster.lore: This lapis gemstone is commonly added to the collection of wizards seeking to improve their presence in combat.

Ethereal Blade.title: Ethereal Blade
Ethereal Blade.lore: A flickering blade of a ghastly nature, it is capable of dealing damage in both magical and physical planes.

Gloves of Haste.title: Gloves of Haste
Gloves of Haste.image: Gloves of Haste itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Gloves of Haste.lore: A pair of magical gloves that seems to render weapons weightless.

Crown.title: Crown
Crown.lore: A stately crown created to ensure a well-meaning but ungifted heir could fend off usurpers and govern with a strong hand.

Crystalys.title: Crystalys
Crystalys.lore: A blade forged from rare crystals, it seeks weak points in enemy armor.

Eul's Scepter of Divinity.title: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
Eul's Scepter of Divinity.image: Eul's Scepter of Divinity itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Eul's Scepter of Divinity.lore: A mysterious scepter passed down through the ages, its disruptive winds can be used for good or evil.

Disperser.title: Disperser
Disperser.lore: Once entrusted to an Apostle General of the Rumusque Faithful's expiditionary force.

Divine Rapier.title: Divine Rapier
Divine Rapier.lore: So powerful, it cannot have a single owner.

Dragon Lance.title: Dragon Lance
Dragon Lance.lore: The forward charge of the wyvern host grants no quarter.

Eye of Skadi.title: Eye of Skadi
Eye of Skadi.image: Eye of Skadi itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Eye of Skadi.lore: Extremely rare artifact, guarded by the azure dragons.

Drum of Endurance.title: Drum of Endurance
Drum of Endurance.image: Drum of Endurance itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Drum of Endurance.lore: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.

Dust of Appearance.title: Dust of Appearance
Dust of Appearance.image: Dust of Appearance itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Dust of Appearance.lore: One may hide visage, but never volume.

Crippling Crossbow.title: Crippling Crossbow
Crippling Crossbow.lore: The ever-weeping woodgrain of this crossbow coats every bolt in a potent but short-lived narcotic sap.
Crippling Crossbow.modifier: this item has no innate modifier

Dormant Curio.title: Dormant Curio
Dormant Curio.lore: Everyone has an idea, but no one has a clue.

Dezun Bloodrite.title: Dezun Bloodrite
Dezun Bloodrite.lore: The gateway to a lost lineage of power, unlocked only with blood.

Divine Regalia.title: Divine Regalia
Divine Regalia.lore: So magnificent, it cannot abide failure.

Medallion of Courage.title: Medallion of Courage
Medallion of Courage.image: Medallion of Courage itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Medallion of Courage.lore: The bearer has no fear of combat.

Hand of Midas.title: Hand of Midas
Hand of Midas.image: Hand of Midas itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Hand of Midas.lore: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner's pockets.

Harpoon.title: Harpoon
Harpoon.lore: A perfect solution for the flight of foes.

Headdress.title: Headdress
Headdress.lore: Creates a soothing aura that restores allies in battle.

Healing Salve.title: Healing Salve
Healing Salve.lore: A magical salve that can quickly mend even the deepest of wounds.

Iron Branch.title: Iron Branch
Iron Branch.lore: A seemingly ordinary branch, its ironlike qualities are bestowed upon the bearer.

Heart of Tarrasque.title: Heart of Tarrasque
Heart of Tarrasque.image: Heart of Tarrasque itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Heart of Tarrasque.lore: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer's fortitude.

Great Healing Lotus.title: Great Healing Lotus
Great Healing Lotus.image: Great Healing Lotus itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Greater Healing Lotus.title: Greater Healing Lotus
Greater Healing Lotus.image: Greater Healing Lotus itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Javelin.title: Javelin
Javelin.lore: A rather typical spear that can sometimes pierce through an enemy's armor when used to attack.

Guardian Greaves.title: Guardian Greaves
Guardian Greaves.lore: One of many holy instruments constructed to honor the Omniscience.

Kaya.title: Kaya
Kaya.lore: The staff of a renowned sorceress, lost for countless millennia.

Maelstrom.title: Maelstrom
Maelstrom.lore: A hammer forged for the gods themselves, Maelstrom allows its user to harness the power of lightning.

Kaya and Sange.title: Kaya and Sange
Kaya and Sange.image: Kaya and Sange itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Kaya and Sange.lore: Two of three known items of unimaginable power that many believe were crafted at the same enchanter's forge.

Heaven's Halberd.title: Heaven's Halberd
Heaven's Halberd.lore: This halberd moves with the speed of a smaller weapon, allowing the bearer to win duels that a heavy edge would not.

Khanda.title: Khanda
Khanda.lore: A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.

Mage Slayer.title: Mage Slayer
Mage Slayer.lore: Forged by a secret order in The Third Age of Praxa'cia to fell the False King.

Linken's Sphere.title: Linken's Sphere
Linken's Sphere.lore: This magical sphere once protected one of the most famous heroes in history.

Magic Stick.title: Magic Stick
Magic Stick.lore: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.

Helm of Iron Will.title: Helm of Iron Will
Helm of Iron Will.image: Helm of Iron Will itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Helm of Iron Will.lore: The helmet of a legendary warrior who fell in battle.

Magic Wand.title: Magic Wand
Magic Wand.lore: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.

Helm of the Dominator.title: Helm of the Dominator
Helm of the Dominator.image: Helm of the Dominator itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Helm of the Dominator.lore: The powerful headpiece of a dead necromancer.

Manta Style.title: Manta Style
Manta Style.lore: An axe made of reflective materials that causes confusion amongst enemy ranks.

Lotus Orb.title: Lotus Orb
Lotus Orb.lore: The jewel at its center still reflects a pale image of its creator.

Helm of the Overlord.title: Helm of the Overlord
Helm of the Overlord.image: Helm of the Overlord itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Helm of the Overlord.lore: The powerful headpiece of an undead necromancer.

Holy Locket.title: Holy Locket
Holy Locket.lore: A prized relic long thought lost forever in a failed crusade.

Mantle of Intelligence.title: Mantle of Intelligence
Mantle of Intelligence.image: Mantle of Intelligence itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Mantle of Intelligence.lore: A beautiful sapphire mantle worn by generations of queens.

Mask of Madness.title: Mask of Madness
Mask of Madness.image: Mask of Madness itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Mask of Madness.lore: Once this mask is worn, its bearer becomes an uncontrollable aggressive force.

Hurricane Pike.title: Hurricane Pike
Hurricane Pike.lore: A legendary pike once held as royal sigil of the ancient wyvern riders.

Mekansm.title: Mekansm
Mekansm.lore: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.

Hyperstone.title: Hyperstone
Hyperstone.lore: A mystical, carved stone that boosts the fervor of the holder.

Meteor Hammer.title: Meteor Hammer
Meteor Hammer.lore: An enchanted hammer forged of metals discovered in the ruins of a village destroyed by a great star storm.

Mana Draught.title: Mana Draught
Mana Draught.lore: A refreshing drink best shared with friends.

Gunpowder Gauntlet.title: Gunpowder Gauntlet
Gunpowder Gauntlet.lore: A 'harmless' prank that went entirely too far.

Kobold Cup.title: Kobold Cup
Kobold Cup.lore: The Kobold King will sip when he damn well pleases.

Jidi Pollen Bag.title: Jidi Pollen Bag
Jidi Pollen Bag.image: Jidi Pollen Bag itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Jidi Pollen Bag.lore: Very dangerous. Very difficult to obtain more.

Idol of Scree'Auk.title: Idol of Scree'Auk
Idol of Scree'Auk.image: Idol of Scree'Auk itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Poor Man's Shield.title: Poor Man's Shield
Poor Man's Shield.image: Poor Man's Shield itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Poor Man's Shield.lore: A busted old shield that seems to block more than it should.

Minotaur Horn.title: Minotaur Horn
Minotaur Horn.lore: The trophy from a mighty beast ambushed and slain in the recesses of its own home.

Possessed Mask.title: Possessed Mask
Possessed Mask.lore: Even when discarded with specific purpose and great care, this frightening mask always finds its way onto the face of a new owner.

Nullifier.title: Nullifier
Nullifier.lore: A dangerous weapon pilfered from an inverse dimension.

Orb of Blight.title: Orb of Blight
Orb of Blight.image: Orb of Blight itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Orb of Blight.lore: An unnerving stone unearthed beneath the Fields of Endless Carnage.

Oblivion Staff.title: Oblivion Staff
Oblivion Staff.lore: Deceptively hidden as an ordinary quarterstaff, it is actually very powerful, much like the Eldritch who originally possessed it.

Observer Ward.title: Observer Ward
Observer Ward.lore: A form of half-sentient plant, often cultivated by apprentice wizards.

Parasma.title: Parasma
Parasma.lore: Warning: There is no antidote if picked up by the wrong end.

Pavise.title: Pavise
Pavise.lore: Devised by a wizard who made one too many enemies.

Perseverance.title: Perseverance
Perseverance.lore: A gem that grants heart to the bearer.

Phase Boots.title: Phase Boots
Phase Boots.lore: Boots that allow the wearer to travel between the ether.

Quelling Blade.title: Quelling Blade
Quelling Blade.lore: The axe of a fallen gnome, it allows you to effectively maneuver the forest.

Occult Bracelet.title: Occult Bracelet
Occult Bracelet.lore: A band that bears effigy of the dark goddess Eloshar's unsleeping eye.

Octarine Core.title: Octarine Core
Octarine Core.lore: At the core of spellcraft are spectrums only the very gifted can sense.

Phylactery.title: Phylactery
Phylactery.lore: An amulet overflowing with powerful magics.

Pipe of Insight.title: Pipe of Insight
Pipe of Insight.image: Pipe of Insight itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Pipe of Insight.lore: A powerful artifact of mysterious origin, it creates barriers against magical forces.

Radiance.title: Radiance
Radiance.lore: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.

Ogre Axe.title: Ogre Axe
Ogre Axe.lore: You grow stronger just by holding it.

Orb of Corrosion.title: Orb of Corrosion
Orb of Corrosion.image: Orb of Corrosion itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Orb of Corrosion.lore: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist's orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.

Reaver.title: Reaver
Reaver.lore: A massive axe capable of tearing whole mountains down.

Platemail.title: Platemail
Platemail.lore: Thick metal plates that protect the entire upper body. Avoid dropping on feet.

Orb of Venom.title: Orb of Venom
Orb of Venom.image: Orb of Venom itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Orb of Venom.lore: Envenoms your veapon with the venom of a venomous viper.

Point Booster.title: Point Booster
Point Booster.lore: A perfectly formed amethyst that nourishes body and mind when held.

Refresher Orb.title: Refresher Orb
Refresher Orb.lore: A powerful artifact created for wizards.

Orchid Malevolence.title: Orchid Malevolence
Orchid Malevolence.lore: A garnet rod constructed from the essence of a fire demon.

Psychic Headband.title: Psychic Headband
Psychic Headband.lore: A failed experiment in finer telekinetic control, still fit for other ends.

Refresher Shard.title: Refresher Shard
Refresher Shard.lore: Across an epoch of endless battle, the Immortal's will to triumph never faltered.

Revenant's Brooch.title: Revenant's Brooch
Revenant's Brooch.lore: The cursed brooch of a [[Muerta|fallen guardian]] who stalks forever between the veil of life and death.

Overwhelming Blink.title: Overwhelming Blink
Overwhelming Blink.lore: A horrifying dagger forged in the chaos maw and nigh untouchable by mortal hands.

Mithril Hammer.title: Mithril Hammer
Mithril Hammer.lore: A hammer forged of pure mithril.

Mjollnir.title: Mjollnir
Mjollnir.lore: Thor's magical hammer, made for him by the dwarves Brok and Eitri.

Monkey King Bar.title: Monkey King Bar
Monkey King Bar.image: Monkey King Bar itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Monkey King Bar.lore: A powerful staff used by a master warrior.

Moon Shard.title: Moon Shard
Moon Shard.lore: Said to be a tear from the lunar goddess Selemene.

Morbid Mask.title: Morbid Mask
Morbid Mask.lore: A mask that drains the energy of those caught in its gaze.

Mystic Staff.title: Mystic Staff
Mystic Staff.lore: Enigmatic staff made of only the most expensive crystals.

Null Talisman.title: Null Talisman
Null Talisman.lore: A small gemstone attached to several chains.

Pollywog Charm.title: Pollywog Charm
Pollywog Charm.lore: A tiny trinket that wriggles when wet.
Pollywog Charm.modifier: this item has no innate modifier

Orb of Frost.title: Orb of Frost
Orb of Frost.image: Orb of Frost itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Orb of Frost.lore: Slowly growing since the universe began, it will envelop everything when it ends.

Spider Legs.title: Spider Legs
Spider Legs.lore: A horrifying yet useful mixture of necromancy and artificing.

Tumbler's Toy.title: Tumbler's Toy
Tumbler's Toy.lore: An antique plaything found in the ruins of an Ozenja circus bazaar.

Sange.title: Sange
Sange.lore: Sange is an unusually accurate weapon, seeking weak points automatically.

Sacred Relic.title: Sacred Relic
Sacred Relic.lore: An ancient weapon that often turns the tides of war.

Sage's Mask.title: Sage's Mask
Sage's Mask.lore: A mask commonly used by mages and warlocks for various rituals.

Sange and Yasha.title: Sange and Yasha
Sange and Yasha.image: Sange and Yasha itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Sange and Yasha.lore: Sange and Yasha, when attuned by the moonlight and used together, become a very powerful combination.

Satanic.title: Satanic
Satanic.lore: Immense power at the cost of your soul.

Scythe of Vyse.title: Scythe of Vyse
Scythe of Vyse.image: Scythe of Vyse itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Scythe of Vyse.lore: The most guarded relic among the cult of Vyse, it is the most coveted weapon among magi.

Talisman of Evasion.title: Talisman of Evasion
Talisman of Evasion.image: Talisman of Evasion itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Talisman of Evasion.lore: A necklace that allows you to anticipate enemy attacks.

Tango.title: Tango
Tango.lore: Forage to survive on the battlefield.

Seeds of Serenity.title: Seeds of Serenity
Seeds of Serenity.lore: An evergreen sprout treasured by the woodkin and highly coveted by interlopers and their like.

Sentry Ward.title: Sentry Ward
Sentry Ward.lore: A form of plant originally grown in the garden of a fearful king.

Ring of Basilius.title: Ring of Basilius
Ring of Basilius.image: Ring of Basilius itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Ring of Basilius.lore: Ring given as a reward to the greatest mages.

Tiara of Selemene.title: Tiara of Selemene
Tiara of Selemene.image: Tiara of Selemene itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Tiara of Selemene.lore: A symbol of favor bestowed upon the high priestess of Selemene.

Town Portal Scroll.title: Town Portal Scroll
Town Portal Scroll.image: Town Portal Scroll itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Ring of Health.title: Ring of Health
Ring of Health.image: Ring of Health itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Ring of Health.lore: A shiny ring found beneath a fat halfling’s corpse.

Tranquil Boots.title: Tranquil Boots
Tranquil Boots.lore: While they increase the longevity of the wearer, this boot is not particularly reliable.

Ring of Protection.title: Ring of Protection
Ring of Protection.image: Ring of Protection itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Ring of Protection.lore: A glimmering ring that defends its bearer.

Shadow Amulet.title: Shadow Amulet
Shadow Amulet.lore: A small talisman that clouds the senses of one's enemies when held perfectly still.

Ring of Regen.title: Ring of Regen
Ring of Regen.image: Ring of Regen itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Ring of Regen.lore: This ring is considered a good luck charm among the Gnomes.

Ring of Tarrasque.title: Ring of Tarrasque
Ring of Tarrasque.image: Ring of Tarrasque itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Ring of Tarrasque.lore: An ageless ring forged with an otherwise simple blood magic amplified by the presumed source of its key component.

Shadow Blade.title: Shadow Blade
Shadow Blade.lore: The blade of a fallen king, it allows you to move unseen and strike from the shadows.

Robe of the Magi.title: Robe of the Magi
Robe of the Magi.image: Robe of the Magi itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Robe of the Magi.lore: This robe corrupts the soul of the user, but provides wisdom in return.

Rod of Atos.title: Rod of Atos
Rod of Atos.image: Rod of Atos itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Rod of Atos.lore: Atos, the Lord of Blight, has his essence stored in this deceptively simple wand.

Shiva's Guard.title: Shiva's Guard
Shiva's Guard.lore: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.

Silver Edge.title: Silver Edge
Silver Edge.lore: Once used to slay an unjust king, only to have the kingdom erupt into civil war in the aftermath.

Skull Basher.title: Skull Basher
Skull Basher.lore: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul's ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.

Slippers of Agility.title: Slippers of Agility
Slippers of Agility.image: Slippers of Agility itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Slippers of Agility.lore: Light boots made from spider skin that tingles your senses.

Smoke of Deceit.title: Smoke of Deceit
Smoke of Deceit.image: Smoke of Deceit itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Smoke of Deceit.lore: The charlatan wizard Myrddin's only true contribution to the arcane arts.

Solar Crest.title: Solar Crest
Solar Crest.lore: A talisman forged to honor the daytime sky.

Soul Ring.title: Soul Ring
Soul Ring.lore: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.

Specialist's Array.title: Specialist's Array
Specialist's Array.lore: An impressive kit of trigger enhancements born in an aging assassin's idle mind.

Spirit Vessel.title: Spirit Vessel
Spirit Vessel.lore: Forged by a god to entrap the soul of another.

Staff of Wizardry.title: Staff of Wizardry
Staff of Wizardry.image: Staff of Wizardry itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Staff of Wizardry.lore: A staff of magical powers passed down from the eldest mages.

Stormcrafter.title: Stormcrafter
Stormcrafter.lore: The accidental byproduct of a spell conjured to entrap a lesser god.

Stygian Desolator.title: Stygian Desolator
Stygian Desolator.lore: The original demonic favorite that served as basis for the beloved mortal design.

Swift Blink.title: Swift Blink
Swift Blink.lore: A cunning blade able to anticipate and enable its bearer's movements.

Searing Signet.title: Searing Signet
Searing Signet.lore: To torture a magic user, one must devise means far beyond the mundane.

Serrated Shiv.title: Serrated Shiv
Serrated Shiv.lore: Too dangerous for taskwork, this blade's only purpose is vile murder.

Witchbane.title: Witchbane
Witchbane.lore: With ready access to test subjects, untold cruelties have been dreamed up and loosed upon the world from within the walls of the Tyler Estate.

Ultimate Orb.title: Ultimate Orb
Ultimate Orb.lore: A mystical orb containing the essence of life.

Urn of Shadows.title: Urn of Shadows
Urn of Shadows.image: Urn of Shadows itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Urn of Shadows.lore: Contains the ashes of powerful demons.

Wind Lace.title: Wind Lace
Wind Lace.lore: Hasten to battle on wind-touched heels.

Wind Waker.title: Wind Waker
Wind Waker.lore: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.

Witch Blade.title: Witch Blade
Witch Blade.lore: A spiteful blade inadvertently possessed by the soul of its incautious creator.

Vanguard.title: Vanguard
Vanguard.lore: A powerful shield that defends its wielder from even the most vicious of attacks.

Yasha.title: Yasha
Yasha.lore: Yasha is regarded as the swiftest weapon ever created.

Yasha and Kaya.title: Yasha and Kaya
Yasha and Kaya.image: Yasha and Kaya itemicon dota2 gameasset.png
Yasha and Kaya.lore: Yasha and Kaya when paired together share a natural resonance.

Veil of Discord.title: Veil of Discord
Veil of Discord.image: Veil of Discord itemicon dota2 gameasset.png

Vitality Booster.title: Vitality Booster
Vitality Booster.lore: A ruby gemstone that has been passed down through generations of warrior kin.

Vladmir's Offering.title: Vladmir's Offering
Vladmir's Offering.lore: An eerie mask that is haunted with the malice of a fallen vampire.

Void Stone.title: Void Stone
Void Stone.lore: Jewelry that was once used to channel nether realm magic, this ring pulses with energy.

Voodoo Mask.title: Voodoo Mask
Voodoo Mask.lore: A mask tuned to sip the arcane bindings that pass between caster and foe.

Wraith Band.title: Wraith Band
Wraith Band.lore: A circlet with faint whispers echoing about it.

Unrelenting Eye.title: Unrelenting Eye
Unrelenting Eye.lore: A serpent's eye the size of a melon (and just as moist).
